## Why visit

An excellent endpoint for a Wirral rail excursion, combining a substantial beer choice with pizza and a comfortable stove-warmed room. The house connection is to Spitting Feathers, while guest beers provide variety beyond the brewery’s own range. Its 2026 local pub award is verified by the branch, making it a particularly timely candidate for this November trip. The nearby coast adds a daylight option, but the beer and food are sufficient reasons to travel even if weather rules out a walk.

## Plan the visit

Wirral CAMRA Pub of the Year 2026. Saturday music can make it busy. Distinct from the Black Lodge tap on Banks Road.

**Getting there:** Close to West Kirby station; a natural pairing with Hoylake stops.
